entities.summary: RTL 102.5 TV is an Italian music television channel, broadcasting as live video feed of the Italian radio station RTL 102.5. It broadcasts on-air transmissions from the studio, as well as music videos cut to fit the radio edit; whenever a song has no official video, a mix of previous videos or a sequence or images chosen from social networks is shown instead.
